args.title: Support additional currency symbols in parseAmount in src/util/money.ts
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update the regex in parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to include the rupee sign (₹) and handle currency symbols like CHF more robustly so that amounts using them parse correctly.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseAmount` function in `src/util/money.ts` uses a regex that strips common currency symbols, but it misses symbols like the rupee sign (₹) and Swiss Francs (CHF). Updating this regex will allow amounts formatted with these currencies to parse properly.
